n=512 is occupancy/panel-LATENCY bound, not GEMM-precision bound: the sequential larfg(reflector build)->trailing-update dependency chain per column serializes. Attack the chain directly: warp-specialize the panel so panel-k+1's reflector build overlaps panel-k's trailing update (software-pipelined producer/consumer across named barriers), and/or pack 2 matrices per CTA to raise ILP/occupancy and hide the per-column MMA+reduction latency. Pure latency-hiding restructure on the existing tf32x3/fp16 algorithm; no precision change. Target the chain that governs the largest-weight shape group.

Panel MB-matrix-packing infra (vector B). _panel_factor2_packed_kernel: MB matrices/CTA on leading (MB,MAXH,BLK) axis, row-axis reductions. Wired via _launch_panel2 behind QR_N512_PANEL_MB (default 1=original, byte-exact). Validated PASS. MEASURED NEGATIVE at MB=2: isolated n512 B=640 3790->4665us (+23%); ncu shows issued-warps/sched 0.54 WORSE than unpacked 0.62 -- the 3D tl.sum(axis=1) is block-cooperative so MB chains don't get independent warp-groups. Packed output passes reference checker (valid alt factorization). Default MB=1 geomean 2192us == parent.

Dual-tile MB=2 packing (vector B, 2nd realization). _panel_factor2_dual_kernel keeps 2 matrices as TWO separate (MAXH,BLK) register tiles so compiler could overlap A-compute with B-reduction-wait. MEASURED NEGATIVE: isolated n512 B=640 3786->4974us (+31%, worse than 3D packing +23%) -- 2 live (512,16) tiles double registers -> heavy spill. Correct (checker PASS). CONCLUSION: (MAXH=512,BLK=16) panel tile too register-heavy to pack any way in Triton; both 3D (cooperative-reduction serialize) and dual (spill) lose. Needs CUDA warp-specialized panel. Default MB=1 unchanged, geomean 2192us.

Correct (checker PASS, scaled_factor 2.31). MEASURED NEGATIVE: isolated n512 B=640 3789->5663us (+49%, worse than smem-CM 4949). DEFINITIVE crossover micro-bench (single panel call, all pheight): Triton WINS at EVERY pheight (512:64us vs cuda_smem 117/cuda_reg 149; 32:16us vs 44/59) -- NO crossover, hybrid won't help. CONCLUSION: all 5 panel-attack variants (Triton 3D-pack +23%, dual-pack +31%, CUDA smem-row +207%, smem-col +30%, register +49%) are correct but SLOWER than Triton. The n512 panel-latency chain is at Triton speed-of-light; smem-reduction/barrier latency irreducible without a different algorithm. Default OFF, geomean 2186us == parent.
